title: Local equality for two specified finite generating lists
statement: Let $(C,J,O)$ be a small ringed site, $I$ a module sheaf, and $\iota:I\to O$ linear. Let $f$ over $U$ and $g$ over $V$ be specified finite generating lists of $I|_U$ and $I|_V$ through $\iota$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators]. For every $a:W\to U$ and $b:W\to V$, there is a covering sieve $S\in J(W)$ such that for each $k:T\to W$ in $S$, the ideals $(O(k a)(f_i))$ and $(O(k b)(g_j))$ in $O(T)$ are equal. Neither monicity of $\iota$ nor fibre products are assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-generators-local-span] on C/U to the finite values of the V-family on W, and in the other direction on C/V. Translate the slice covering sieves to covering sieves of W and intersect them. Naturality and the prescribed terminal values identify the generator images with the restrictions of f and g. Applying ι to the linear expressions puts each generator in the other ideal, proving both inclusions.

theorem exists_cover_generatingLists_ideal_eq
    (U : C) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → O.obj.obj (op U))
    (hf : IsRingedIdealGeneratingList O I ι U r f)
    (V : C) (s : ℕ) (g : Fin s → O.obj.obj (op V))
    (hg : IsRingedIdealGeneratingList O I ι V s g)
    (W : C) (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V) :
    ∃ S ∈ J W, ∀ (T : C) (k : T ⟶ W), S k →
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ O.obj.map (k ≫ a).op (f i))) =
        Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ O.obj.map (k ≫ b).op (g i)))
